headline: Hawai'i Pacific catch Vanguard at the top of the table
dek: Hawai'i Pacific won at Chaminade on the last day of conference play to finish level on points with Vanguard, having won every conference match since Westmont beat them in October. Across the whole season they have won eight matches and lost five; Vanguard and Westmont alone still have a match to play.
displaced_by: Hawai'i Pacific beat Chaminade to finish level on points with Vanguard, and Vanguard now have a match against Westmont to play, so neither 'on top' nor 'finish their schedule' still holds.
